story.iWant: to expose the Auth logic over Swagger-documented REST controllers
story.soThat: interaction with the auth system is strictly structured via class-validators and immediately testable through a GUI
story.tasks: - Create `auth.controller.ts` with routing prefixes - Define explicit DTO classes (`LoginDto`, `RegisterDto`) - Bind DTOs to standard validation pipes globally - Decorate controllers using `@ApiTags`, `@ApiOperation`, and `@ApiResponse`

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Validation pipes throw HTTP 400 when missing payloads in POST endpoints.
DTO fields render correctly in Swagger interface.
The login controller successfully hooks into the AuthService to issue a JWT response.
